(Phoenix, Arizona) | college = [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]] (2020–2022) | highlights = * [[Pac-12 Conference|Pac-12]] All-Defensive Team (2022) }} '''Dalen Lee Terry''' (born July 12, 2002) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona Wildcats]]. As a sophomore in 2022, he was named to the Pac-12 All-Defensive Team. ==High school career== Terry is a native of [[Phoenix, Arizona]] and attended [[Corona del Sol High School]] in [[Tempe, Arizona]] where he played with teammates [[Alex Barcello]] and [[Saben Lee]] before transferring to Hillcrest Prep in Phoenix, playing alongside future Arizona basketball recruit [[Deandre Ayton]].{{cite web |title=He’s like the centerpiece’: Dalen Terry’s impact on Arizona might extend beyond the court |url=https://theathletic.com/1106917/2019/08/02/hes-like-the-centerpiece-dalen-terrys-impact-on-arizona-might-extend-beyond-the-court/}}{{cite web |title=Do-it-all freshman Dalen Terry is ‘living the dream’ with Arizona Wildcats |url=https://www.azdesertswarm.com/basketball/2020/12/15/22176872/dalen-terry-arizona-wildcats-dream-school-versatility-hillcrest-prep}} In two years at Hillcrest, Terry averaged 15.8 points, 7.4 rebounds, 10.3 assists, 3.7 steals, and 1.9 blocks per game.{{cite web |title=Dalen Terry's Basketball Stats |url=https://www.maxpreps.com/athlete/dalen-terry/Tj7HgNIjEeiAxKkkK9HIDg/basketball/stats.htm}} He played his [[Amateur Athletic Union|AAU]] basketball Compton Magic with other [[Pac-12 Conference|Pac-12]] players such as [[Johnny Juzang]], [[Isaiah Mobley]], [[Evan Mobley]] and [[Onyeka Okongwu]]. ===Recruiting=== Terry was a consensus four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] in the 2020 class and the No. 46 overall player, according to [[247Sports]]. On July 23, 2019, he committed to playing [[college basketball]] for [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]], being the first commit in the 2020 class for Arizona.{{cite web |title=2020 4-star wing Dalen Terry commits to Arizona |url=https://www.azdesertswarm.com/basketball/2019/7/23/20707998/dalen-terry-commits-arizona-wildcats-basketball-recruiting-2020-class-rankings-highlights-scouting}} Terry had offers from [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]], [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]], [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|California]], [[Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball|Colorado]], [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]], [[Utah Utes men's basketball|Utah]] and [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]], among others. He was joined in the 2020 recruiting class by [[Bennedict Mathurin]], [[Ąžuolas Tubelis]] and [[Kerr Kriisa]] among others to give Arizona the Number 7 overall recruiting class for 2020.{{cite web |title=Arizona 2020 Basketball Commits (7) |url=https://247sports.com/college/arizona/Season/2020-Basketball/Commits/}} {{College Athlete Recruit Start|40=no|collapse=no|year=2020}} {{College Athlete Recruit Entry | recruit = Dalen Terry | position = [[Small forward|SF]] | hometown = [[Phoenix, Arizona|Phoenix, AZ]] | highschool = Hillcrest Prep (AZ) | feet = 6 | inches = 6 | weight = 190 | 40 = | commitdate = July 23, 2019 | scout stars = | rivals stars = 4 | 247 stars = 4 | espn stars = 4 | espn grade = 84 }} {{College Athlete Recruit End | 40 = | year = 2020 | rivals ref title = Arizona 2020 Basketball Commitments | scout ref title = | espn ref title = 2020 Arizona Wildcats Recruiting Class | rivals school = arizona | scout s = | espn schoolid = 12 | 247 overall = 46 | rivals overall = 51 | espn overall = 63 | accessdate = September 5, 2020 | bball = yes }} ==College career== As a freshman at Arizona, Terry appeared in all 26 games for the Wildcats, starting 14 of them while averaging 4.6 points, 3.2 rebounds, 1.5 assists per game.{{cite web |title=CAREER HIGHLIGHTS |url=https://arizonawildcats.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/dalen-terry/12919}} His highest point total came against in-state rival [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]], scoring 13 points, while shooting 3-of-3 from three-point range. Arizona would be placed on self-imposed post season ban, thus Terry would not play in the [[2021 Pac-12 Conference Men's Basketball Tournament|2021 Pac-12 Tournament]] or the [[2021 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2021 NCAA Tournament]]. In his sophomore season, he would start all 37 games for the Wildcats, where he averaged eight points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.9 assists and 1.2 steals per game. He finished second in the Pac-12 in assist-to-turnover ratio (2.84), sixth in assists per game (3.92), eighth in FG% (50.2) and ninth in steals per game (1.24).{{cite web |title=CAREER HIGHLIGHTS |url=https://arizonawildcats.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/dalen-terry/12919}} He became one of the marquee defensive players in the conference earning him All-Defensive First Team. Terry helped Arizona to a 33–4 record, winning the [[Roman Main Event|2021 Roman Main Event]], [[2021–22 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Conference Regular Season]] and [[2022 Pac-12 Conference Men's Basketball Tournament|2022 Pac-12 Tournament]] Titles. Arizona returned to the [[2022 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2022 NCAA Tournament]] for the first time since 2018. He would score a career-high 17 points in his final game as a Wildcat against [[Houston Cougars men's basketball|Houston]]. On April 22, 2022, Terry declared for the [[2022 NBA draft]] while maintaining his college eligibility. He later decided to remain in the draft.{{cite web |title=Arizona guard, potential first-rounder Dalen Terry to remain in NBA Draft |url=https://theathletic.com/news/arizona-guard-potential-first-rounder-dalen-terry-to-remain-in-nba-draft/3tu7vZjAUaBc/?amp=1 |website=[[The Athletic]] |access-date=June 3, 2022 |date=May 31, 2022}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2020–21 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] | 26 || 14 || 20.7 || .415 || .326 || .614 || 3.2 || 1.5 || .7 || '''.4''' || 4.6 |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2021–22 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] | '''37''' || '''37''' || '''27.8''' || '''.502''' || '''.364''' || '''.736''' || '''4.8''' || '''3.9''' || '''1.2''' || .3 || '''8.0''' |- class="sortbottom" | style="text-align:center;" colspan="2"| Career | 63 || 51 || 24.9 || .477 || .350 || .680 || 4.2 || 2.9 || 1.0 || .3 || 6.6 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://arizonawildcats.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/dalen-terry/12919 Arizona Wildcats bio] *[https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/t/terry-dalen.aspx USA Basketball bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Terry, Dalen}} [[Category:2002 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Phoenix, Arizona]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Arizona Wildcats men's basketball players]]
